title: Mirror the Workers-AI-only cloud rule on the TS factory side (worker-boot harness/model defaults, RUN_MODEL)
body: nwn enforces the rule in Go's profile.Resolve, which covers everything the Go reconciler dispatches. The factory's TypeScript boot path picks a harness (WORKER_DEFAULT_HARNESS, run/deployment config) and RUN_MODEL independently; nothing there refuses a non-Workers-AI model or a harness that cannot reach the gateway. One declared rule, shared or mirrored and tested for parity, would close the remaining path.
